items.summary: Sanitize PII/secrets (FEIN, SSN, names, credentials) from text or files with the local ClaimCheck CLI before anything leaves the machine; reversible via the local vault.

latestVersion.changelog: Recognized list now includes the full category set: CVV, card expiry, dates of birth, passports, [DL_3], bank routing, IP addresses, street addresses, medical licenses, insurance member IDs

items.summary: Dueback: outcome-based bill negotiation. Detect negotiable bills, fees, and purchases; Dueback's backend negotiates and verifies savings against bank data. Free to try — pay only on verified savings.

latestVersion.changelog: Adds section 6 savings scan (consent ask at case completion, candidate list, explicit per-case open, revoke) and updates pricing: standard 15% recurring / 10% one-off, founding-beta first 20 cases at 10% recurring / 5% one-off.

items.summary: Quick health check on a public GitHub repo before depending on it — stars, days since last push, license, archived flag, and a health heuristic. Single unauthenticated API call. Use when the user asks whether a GitHub repo is maintained, trustworthy, or safe to adopt.

latestVersion.changelog: Add lite-vs-full section + evidence-based upgrade hint in script output
